selected_original_scopes.summary: Older exponential qEPI holds every transmissivity and gives linear entropy bound; weaker than EPnI for unequal entropies. It already bounds possible photon-number deficit and broadcast outerregion; no new benefit from equal-entropy identity or thermal-state recalculation.

Coherent Gaussian superposition achieves the same broadcast rate shapes; converse depended on StrongConjecture2. Already allowed lossy receiver coefficients and entire-codebook photon averaging. Old figures/rates use bits versus current nats; convert bases. Source theorem supplies missing entropy premise,not a new encoder/decoder implementation.

result_notes.thm:epni: Finite integer n>=1, FULL untruncated bosonic Fock states with finite mean total number. Two ports JOINT PRODUCT rhoA tensor rhoB; arbitrary entanglement WITHIN either port allowed. Same passive transmissivity eta in[0,1] at each mode; reduced retained output. gInv(SC/n)>=eta*gInv(SA/n)+(1-eta)*gInv(SB/n), all natural logs. Product identical-per-port thermals attain equality with unequal port means. Not correlated ports, unequal mode attenuation, amplifier or physical energy equality.
result_notes.cor:thermal-attenuator: Finite n>=1, finite entropy per mode s>=0 and thermal environment mean NB>=0; identical passive attenuator each mode, independent PRODUCT thermal environment. Exact minimum output entropy/n at input S=ns is g(eta*gInv(s)+(1-eta)*NB), attained by product thermal input. Allows entangled input modes, not uniqueness or arbitrary Gaussian channels. Natural consequence C,outside selected formal endpoint.
result_notes.lem:gibbs-variational: Faithful sigma, finite S(rho) and cross entropy imply Umegaki D>=0 with equality iff rho=sigma. Bounded-below K with finite nonzero partition Z gives unique Gibbs minimizer ONLY if Gibbs state belongs to admitted class; no arbitrary unbounded differentiation.
result_notes.lem:energy-compactness: Fixed finite mode n and COMMON finite mean-number cap E give trace-norm compactness and entropy continuity,0<=S<=n*g(E/n). Number-cutoff tail q<=E/(K+1),entropy tail controlled by H2(q)+q*n*g(E/(q*n)). Normalized compressions converge with bounded energies; no entropy continuity without common energy constraint.
result_notes.prop:thermal-mixing: Independent ports carry identical-per-mode product thermal states tau_rs; nonnegative lambdas sum1, same passive rotation all modes. Retained joint state tau_sum(lambda*rs), including vacuum limits. Does not Gaussianize arbitrary inputs or remove port independence.
result_notes.thm:interpolation: Positive DIAGONAL forms on source/targets, fixed linear maps Li and positive wi. Each source test has FINITELY MANY parameter VALUES(m>0,x,y real), testspace invariant under scalar functions of tuple. Four comparisons with mf(x)e^+/-x and mf(y)e^+/-y imply F=m*f(x)*f(y)/f(x+y),f=x/sinhx,f0=1. Targets unrestricted nonnegative sums/Fatou. No commutation compatibility between Li and multipliers, but all FOUR hypotheses/test invariance required; finite parameter values not finite coordinate support.
result_notes.int:stieltjes: B defined by B(f(x)^2)=x*cothx for x>=0 extends holomorphically upperhalfplane/across positive axis,real strictlydecreasing,B1=1,Bprime1=-1. -Bprime(s)=c+integral nu(dr)/(s+r),c>=0,positive nu,integral(1+r)^-1 finite. Herglotz and inverse conformal parametrization supply representation; no arbitrary product-of-weights closure.
result_notes.lem:gibbs-regularity: W=1+N,k>0,B bounded positive; closed form K=kW4+W^1/2 B W^1/2 on D(W2) has compact inverse. Faithful Gibbs exp(-K)/Z has finite SEVENTH moment and uniquely minimizes energy-minus-entropy among finite FOURTH-moment states. Uniform control as k->0 not asserted.
result_notes.prop:regularized-minimum: After fixed strict finite-support witness and ordered positive references/thermal port/epsilon/output replacement kappa, every zeta in(0,zeta0] attains Jzeta<=-c. Input mean energies uniform in zeta; faithful seventh-moment states,Hs<=CsW4,H0<=CW. Exact Gibbs logarithm identity with sliced H0,epsilon energy and zetaW4. Seventh-moment/log bounds need NOT be uniform in zeta.
result_notes.prop:hessian: ONLY at these regularized minima, centered output slice Li=(TiZ-mean I)/sqrt(lambda_i) has squared logarithmic-mean norm <=(1+epsilon)/(1-kappa) times output norm. Finite EIGENblock perturbations,centered identity tail and dual Gibbs Hessian argument; NOT universal channel contraction or number-basis finite truncation.
result_notes.prop:metric: At minima, independent-port arithmetic variance comparisons plus Hessian/slack supply four weights. Thermal F_s=(1/h_s)*f(h_s v/2)*f(-h_s/2)/f(h_s(v-1)/2) has removable v1 and fixed positive upper/lower bounds. Equal to tilted logmean via ell(p_l,p_r)F=ell(r p_l,(r+1)p_r). Not universal metric monotonicity for arbitrary state/channel.
result_notes.lem:dual-finiteness: At minimizing states seventh moment and H<=CW4 give absolute K and vK logarithmic sums; centered thermal defect dual norm=sum(1-v)K|dprime_lr|² finite. Only centering removes expectation,not arbitrary unbounded-operator domain assumptions.
result_notes.lem:weak-traces: For bounded output observables, thermal defect convolution has sum_i w_i qi(LiZ) PLUS kappa(1-kappa)*conjugate(mu_gamma)*Tr[(gamma-tau)Z]. Finite energy/Hilbert-Schmidt weak products justify slices/discarded commutators; replacement correction cannot be dropped when mean nonzero.
result_notes.prop:defect-estimate: At minima A²=sum wi||qi||²,M²=sum wi|mui|²:||q0||<=A+sqrt(2kappa)C0 M. Choose kappa<=epsilon²/[4(epsilon+2)C0²] AFTER fixed references/epsilon,uniform zeta; squared bound A²+epsilon/2(A²+M²). Defects also vanish on DISPLACED thermals,so means need separate control.
result_notes.lem:generator-covariance: At minima weighted W² delta W² trace class/traceless. Thermal-relaxation generator covariance delta0=(1-kappa)sumPhi_i(delta_i); logarithmic slicing holds. Finite joint-cutoff covariance algebra itself permits correlated joint operators,while actual product-port model and other steps still require independence. This does NOT extend whole EPnI to correlated inputs.
result_notes.lem:entropy-production: At minima sigma=Tr(delta H)/h=||q||dual²-(eprime-nr). Generator number drift separately includes -|mu|². Exact Gibbs stationarity cancels centered energies,retains negative mean and replacement terms; no need positive two-sided rho+t*delta or entropy derivative along unbounded semigroup.
result_notes.cor:broadcast-capacity: Memoryless TWO-receiver PURE-LOSS classical broadcast,0<=etaC<etaB,etaB+etaC<=1,independent auxiliary vacua; input finite-energy codewords may entangle across uses. Finite mean-number bound averaged over ENTIRE uniform independent product message codebook AND uses. Separate collective decoding/vanishing AVERAGE error,no cooperation/feedback. Closed convex hull of nonnegative RB<=g(etaB*beta*Nbar),RC<=g(etaC*Nbar)-g(etaC*beta*Nbar),beta[0,1],NATs/use. Not finite-block error exponent/per-codeword bound/thermal-noise broadcast/quantum capacity.
